prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Katy, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1261; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the sideswipe collision you reported. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just give you the details of what happened, if that's okay.

Q: That's fine, but I still need your name for the file. Can you confirm it for me?

A: Yes, it's the name on the policy. You already have it.

Q: Understood. Where did the collision take place?

A: On the highway in Katy, Texas, near one of the exits. I was moving from the center lane over to the right lane.

Q: Walk me through what you were doing right before impact.

A: I checked my mirror, saw a gap, and signaled. I started to move over, and then I felt a bump on my passenger side. The other car had come up alongside me and scraped my door as it passed.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before you began your lane change?

A: Not clearly. I think it was in my blind spot. I didn't see it until the contact happened.

Q: Did either vehicle stop after the contact?

A: Mine pulled to the shoulder. The other car kept going for a bit and then slowed down.

Q: Were you injured?

A: My head hit the window when I jerked the wheel. I've had headaches since, and I've been dizzy and sensitive to light. A doctor has told me I have a concussion.

Q: Are you currently receiving treatment for that?

A: Yes, I'm seeing a physician and I'm taking a few days off work to rest.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I'm willing to provide photos of my vehicle and the medical paperwork.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
